'''Teeko Soonca''' was a quiet, reserved [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. He served as a sales executive for a Rodian-run company with [[Ruku Kooff]] and [[Mannee Swaano]]. 

After they were close in finalizing an agreement with a group of off-worlders, the Rodians invited them to a hunting expedition/vacation to a [[Hunting_lodge|luxurious hunting lodge/resort]] in a [[jungle/Legends|jungle]] game preserve. As he was the leader of the group, Ruku and Mannee would often go to great lengths to accomplish what Teeko ordered.

Meanwhile, bounty hunters who were after Kooff, broke into their rooms, planted [[transponder beacon/Legends|transponders]] in their luggage, and tampered with their [[comlink/Legends|comlinks]] and [[Blaster power pack/Legends|power packs]]. 

Indeed, despite the break-in, the Rodians and their customers would proceed as planned, and after attempting to buy supplies from [[Whool (Rodian)|Whool]] (which sooner or later also proved to be tampered), half an hour on their way to the hunting camp, their sabotaged airspeeder broke down. Stranded in the jungle, the group attempted to find their way back to the lodge through rivers, [[Quicksand/Legends|quicksands]] and fight predators with their tampered equipment. Swaano proved a troublemaker during the effort.

They spotted an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] beyond some mountains and made a shortcut through some [[cave/Legends|caves]], where they had to fight [[Newoongall]]s and ambushing bounty hunters, who killed Ruku. The survivors had to leave her body behind to escape the hunters.

Eventually they reached the airspeeder, and found their way back to the lodge. The Chattza Protectors questioned them, and explained they had arranged the ambush as Ruku was in reality a criminal wanted by [[Navik the Red]]; he didn't know that Mannee was the source of this information, somehow having seen behind Ruku's false identity. 

The two Rodians finalized the deal with the off-worlders, promising a bonus if they kept silent about the embarassing "invonceniences".
